# Uptrue — llms.txt
# https://uptrue.io/llms.txt
# Format: https://llmstxt.org

> Uptrue is a SaaS uptime and infrastructure monitoring platform for web agencies and development teams. It monitors websites, APIs, SSL certificates, DNS records, and server ports — alerting teams instantly when something goes wrong. Key features include AI-powered executive reports, public status pages, competitor price tracking, and a free AI SEO checker tool.

## About

Uptrue is built and operated by Vision Software Solutions Limited (Company No. 02710980), registered in Brentford, United Kingdom. The platform is hosted on Vercel with data stored in Supabase (EU Frankfurt region). All user data is GDPR compliant and encrypted at rest.

Contact: support@uptrue.io
Privacy: https://uptrue.io/privacy
Terms: https://uptrue.io/terms

## Core Product

- [Uptime Monitoring](https://uptrue.io/#features): HTTP/HTTPS monitoring with 30-second check intervals, two-region confirmation to eliminate false alarms, and multi-channel alerts (email, Slack, Teams, webhook).
- [10 Monitor Types](https://uptrue.io/#features): HTTP uptime, SSL certificate expiry, DNS record changes, keyword presence/absence, domain expiry, port availability, ping/ICMP, API endpoint validation, heartbeat (cron job monitoring), and competitor tracking.
- [Public Status Pages](https://uptrue.io/#features): Branded, embeddable status pages that update in real time when incidents are created or resolved. Visitors can subscribe to updates.
- [AI-Powered Reports](https://uptrue.io/#features): Executive summaries generated by Claude AI, analysing uptime trends and incident patterns in plain language for clients and stakeholders.
- [Multi-Channel Alerts](https://uptrue.io/#features): Instant notifications via email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and webhook. HMAC-signed webhook payloads for security.
- [Competitor Tracking (Compete)](https://uptrue.io/#features): Monitor competitor prices and stock levels on any ecommerce site. Automated alerts on price changes.

## Free Tools

- [Free AI SEO Checker](https://uptrue.io/tools/ai-seo-checker): Analyse any website's AI search readiness across 4 categories — crawler access, content structure, trust signals, and schema/technical. Generates a 0–100 AI readiness score. No signup required.
- [Free SSL Checker](https://uptrue.io/score): Instant SSL certificate expiry check, grade, and issuer details for any domain.
- [Free Uptime Calculator](https://uptrue.io/score): Calculate the cost of downtime — revenue impact, SLA breach risk, and recovery time estimates.
- [Public Uptime Tracker](https://uptrue.io/tracker): Live uptime data for 100+ of the world's most-used platforms and SaaS tools.
- [Uptime Leaderboard](https://uptrue.io/leaderboard): Rankings of websites by uptime reliability.

## AI Visibility Features (Dashboard)

- [llms.txt Generator](https://uptrue.io/dashboard/ai-visibility): Generate a tailored llms.txt file for your own website, optimised for selected AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Grok, Exa).
- [AI Citation Monitor](https://uptrue.io/dashboard/ai-visibility): Track whether AI search engines cite your website for target keywords. Async checks with email notification on completion.

## Pricing

- Free: £0/month — 3 monitors, 10-minute checks, email alerts
- Lite: £10/year — 5 monitors, 1-minute checks
- Builder: £15/month — 25 monitors, AI reports, Slack/Teams alerts
- Scale: £39/month — 100 monitors, 30-second checks, full API access

All plans are month-to-month (no lock-in). Subscriptions can be paused for up to 3 months.
